trap.label: according to
trap.wrong: We use different registers according the situation.
trap.right: We use different registers according to the situation.
trap.why: Em português “de acordo com” é só uma expressão, e o aluno omite o to final. Em inglês, according to é fixo.

fix.wrong: A prescriptive rule tell us how we should speak.
fix.right: A prescriptive rule tells us how we should speak.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com according to: “By the situation we change register.”
rewrite.answer: We change register according to the situation.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no plural: “A dialect is regional.”
Reescreva no negativo: “It is a social dialect.”
rewrite.answer: It is not a social dialect.
